subject: Follow-up: Buying circle & legal evidence for Redwood trial
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Robbins <ava.robbins@clearwaveanalytics.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 May 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + ask: buying circle & next steps for proof-of-concept

Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a small ask so we can get legal/procurement moving: 

What I heard on the call:
- Goal: 8-week evaluation of Redwood inference on a 1-2 model pilot (customer search + chat workflows)
- Success criteria: <10% regression on response quality vs. current baseline; median p95 latency under 300ms for 1k qps slices
- Constraints: budget held on platform team (TBD), SOC2 + data residency checklist required by legal

Can you do two things for us so we can scope the contract and LoE?
1) Confirm the economic buyer / budget owner (name & email).
2) Share the procurement intake contact (legal or vendor management) and any timing constraints for May/June approvals.

I attached a one-pager (redwood-quickstart-sla.pdf) and our SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary-2024.pdf) to speed up review. If easier, I can put together a short mutual action plan that maps deliverables to approvers.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm budget owner by Tue 5/27
- We schedule a 30-min handoff with procurement/legal the week of 6/2

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-quickstart-sla.pdf (1 page PDF)
- SOC2-summary-2024.pdf (2 page PDF)

From: Ava Robbins <ava.robbins@clearwaveanalytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 26 May 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: buying circle & next steps for proof-of-concept

On Sat, May 24, 2025 at 2:05 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and a small ask so we can get legal/procurement moving:
> ...

Thanks, Ben — great recap. Short answers below and a couple of notes from our side.

Budget owner: Diego Ramos (Director, Platform Engineering) — diego.ramos@clearwaveanalytics.com. He owns the P&L for eval pilots.
Procurement intake: We use an internal vendor intake form and then route to Legal; I can kick off the form but Legal will expect SOC2 evidence and a short statement on data retention.
Timing: Diego is out Thurs–Fri this week, but aiming for an internal approval window by 6/12. Legal will probably need 5–7 business days after intake.

If you can send a one-slide summary for Diego (cost buckets + expected monthly run-rate for the pilot) that would help speed the budget confirmation. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS (we need key separation for logs)?

Happy to join the intake call once Diego is back — cc'ing him on my next email.

Best,
Ava

--
Ava Robbins
Product Operations Manager, Clearwave Analytics
ava.robbins@clearwaveanalytics.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@clearwaveanalytics.com>, Ava Robbins <ava.robbins@clearwaveanalytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 May 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Intro + quick answers re: KMS and evidence

Diego — nice to e-meet you. Ben and I ran through a short technical checklist during the demo and flagged a couple items legal typically asks for. High level answers below; happy to hop on a 20-min call to walk through any of these.

- Customer-managed KMS: Yes — Redwood Private and Dedicated deployments support customer KMS (we integrate with AWS KMS and GCP KMS / bring-your-own HSM for on-prem). For Hosted we offer an optional envelope encryption pattern; we can document options in the SOW.
- Data retention & logs: We can configure per-customer retention windows and provide filtered audit logs. We provide an exportable audit trail for requests tied to API keys.
- SOC2 evidence: attached SOC2-summary-2024.pdf. We can also provide a redacted AICPA bridge letter on request.

Ben — attaching a very brief slide (link below) that lays out pilot cost scenarios (baseline / with caching / heavy quantization) so Diego can see monthly run-rate ranges. If you prefer, I can convert to a one-page PO-ready summary.

Suggested next steps:
1) Ben to send one-slide cost summary to Diego by EOD Tue 5/27.
2) Ava to start vendor intake form and share Legal contact.
3) Quick alignment call: Thu 5/29 10:00am PT (20 min) — propose calendar invite; will include Marissa (CS) to cover onboarding readiness.

Links:
- Pilot cost scenarios: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding-plan
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/CLW-2025-0419

Thanks,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

Diego — following up with the one-slide summary we discussed (link below). Short version:
- 8-week pilot estimate: $12,500–$18,000/mo depending on model family and caching profile
- Typical add-ons: dedicated logging retention or customer-managed KMS may add a fixed setup fee (one-time) + minimal monthly KMS usage

One-slide: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-redwood-onboarding-plan
Attachments: redwood-quickstart-sla.pdf, SOC2-summary-2024.pdf

We also proposed a 20-min alignment call Thu 5/29 at 10:00am PT to:
- Walk procurement/legal checklist
- Confirm approver list and timing
- Agree on pilot deliverables & success criteria

If that time doesn't work, suggest alternative windows Thu 5/29 2:00pm PT or Fri 5/30 9:00am PT.

Thanks for looping in Diego — look forward to aligning.

Regards,
Ben
